releaseName: Lokify v1.4.9 – High Accuracy Hardware GPS & Amazon-Style Google Account Sign-In
changelog: High-Accuracy GPS & Locality: Added native Android hardware GPS & native Geocoder service. Real-time satellite fix with accurate neighborhood, ward, and city locality (no hardcoded fallback).
Amazon-Style Google Sign-In: Sleek, human-crafted Google Account Chooser bottom sheet showing real Google accounts registered on device with instant 1-tap sign-in and 'Use another account' option.
Eliminated Coarse / Stale Location: Replaced Webview timeout limitations with direct Android LocationManager and multi-provider reverse geocoding engine.
Official Lokify.apk: Signed standalone Android release package with direct in-app package installer integration.
